SELECT SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders o  WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2025-01-01' AND o.channel = 'online'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders o WHERE o.status = 'shipped'

question: Выручка по категориям товаров за 2026 год по позициям заказов

interpretations.gold_sql: SELECT cat.name AS category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.created_at >= '2026-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY cat.name
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cities FROM cities

SELECT SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.created_at >= '2025-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2026-01-01' AND c.segment = 'b2b'
